text:
maria: Quick thread for tomorrow's sync — exploring a visual hierarchy for "quiet periods" in the alert preview. Goal: scannable timeline + clear channel context without adding vertical height. Mock: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/qp-hierarchy.png

ben: Proposal: two-column row left = channel groups + badges, right = compact timeline with stacked segments. Keeps labels readable and timeline tight.

anil: Accessibility checklist starter: 1) timeline must be keyboard-navigable (left/right) 2) each segment needs an accessible name (e.g., "Pager quiet 10:000-10:30") 3) don't rely on color alone 1 for overlap show a patterned border or icon.

lisa: Copy callout: we debated "Quiet windows" vs "Quiet periods". My vote: "Quiet windows" reads faster in a sentence: "Quiet windows are active for 3 channels." But "Quiet periods" is fine too. Keep sentence case.

devin: Implementation note: avoid rendering >20 individual segments. Backend returns grouped windows by medium. Example payload: `quiet_windows: [{group: 'Pager', start:'', end:'', count:2}]` 1 that keeps frontend cheap.

tara: Mobile fallback: render a compact chip "3 channels quiet" + chevron. Tap opens bottom sheet with full timeline and per-channel details. No hover-only affordances.

jake: Screen reader text idea: announce on focus "Quiet windows timeline, 3 items. Use left and right arrow keys to navigate." Use `role=list` / `role=listitem` and aria-posinset/aria-setsize. Also add polite live region updates on changes.

maria: UX nits: show a small "auto" badge for system-snoozes and tooltip: "Auto-snooze: triggered by incident policy." Also show the source in the timeline label.

ben: Visual nit: timeline separators need to be 2px at least and use tokenized colors (not raw hex) so dark mode/contrast toggles work.

lisa: Final copy suggestions: header: "Quiet windows" helper: "Temporarily pause notifications for selected channels." pill: "3 channels quiet" button: "Edit quiet window" tooltip for auto: "Auto-snooze (policy)"

anil: I'll draft a short a11y micro-spec (roles, SR strings, keyboard mapping, contrast thresholds) and drop it in the design doc.

maria: Action items: maria -> update mocks (compact row + two-column variant), anil -> a11y micro-spec, lisa -> finalize copy strings, devin -> API grouped windows shape, tara -> mobile bottom sheet flow, jake -> keyboard doc. I'll upload updated art before EOD.

design-bot: Mock v1 uploaded: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/qp-hierarchy-v1.png (uploaded by maria)

maria: Thanks all 1 ping me in DMs for urgent blockers.
